counting: NFC plain text. Report Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes. Drafts use no combining sequences, emoji, ZWJ or supplementary code points; character-count ambiguity therefore does not affect these limits. Final App Store Connect validation remains authoritative.
notes: All text lengths include spaces and punctuation. Notes TXT file counts include their final newline.
StoreKit configuration locales en_US/ru_RU are not copied as authoring locale IDs; storefront drafts are labeled en-US and ru.
Review notes are one nonlocalized field: English is the proposed submitted variant; Russian is a translation/review alternative, not a second field to concatenate.
